proposal.description:
Refund Exodus Town

Exchange each eligible TOWN NFT for the MANA paid in its settled auction. Rights follow the current NFT holder. Refunded NFTs are transferred to ExodusDAO. Individual and bulk refunds are supported. No claim deadline.

Chain: 137
Snapshot block: 96050645
Snapshot block hash: 0x9fdcb590367e89bb6603863a0778feacb03e39f4e73a77c0a944d1d955c674f7
Snapshot data: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/exodus-town/refund/main/public/snapshots/0x11cb2dc9e270fca11a72ec801cd20b34856f7925aa549b98437aad2cd08bc9da.json
Snapshot file keccak256: 0x11cb2dc9e270fca11a72ec801cd20b34856f7925aa549b98437aad2cd08bc9da
Merkle root: 0xb37eb4c5eac13888782e8ad9a820240e4701363e3727b838344516aa35b1b4e6
Eligible NFTs: 229
Total MANA (base units): 25569340000000000000000
Redemption contract: 0x4597d46C178C0B11d0F17ACb62bE81555D471524

Only settled, positive-price auctions through the snapshot block are eligible. Later auctions and mints are excluded. The active auction is not settled by this proposal. Pause auctions, then Transfer the exact allocation from the DAO treasury and activate redemption atomically. Publish the complete snapshot file with this proposal so anyone can reproduce the root.

This proposal distributes MANA only; it does not liquidate any other DAO assets.
